questions.question: Which of these are form elements mentioned in the text (multiple answers)? Choices: password; checkboxes; username; drop down list.
Which of these do we use in our input fields to refer back to it in our code? Choices: action; id; method; name.
Which of these tells the page where to send the information? Choices: id; action; name; method.
Which of these tells the page how to send the information? Choices: action; name; id; method.
Which method attaches information onto the URL (also known as URI or Uniform Resource Identifier)? Choices: POST; GET.
Which method should not be used if you are sending passwords or confidential information? Choices: GET; POST.
Which of these assists with data validation by specifying what belongs in the input field? Choices: autofocus; placeholder; type.
Which of these tells the user what should be typed in the input field? Choices: type; autofocus; placeholder.
Which of these will put the cursor in the field you specify? Choices: placeholder; type; autofocus.
Which of these input types allow you to specify the minimum number, maximum number, step count, and the starting value? Choices: number; range; URL; email.
